# CuteFela

CuteFela is an environmental organisation rooted in Sri Lanka working across biodiversity protection, environmental learning, sustainable livelihoods, disaster response and environmental governance.

## Core pages
- https://www.cutefela.com/ — overview
- https://www.cutefela.com/who-we-are.html — vision, mission and organisational approach
- https://www.cutefela.com/work.html — initiative overview
- https://www.cutefela.com/school-programs.html — Empowering Youth & Children school programme
- https://www.cutefela.com/wildlife-rehabilitation.html — wildlife rehabilitation project
- https://www.cutefela.com/disaster-response.html — disaster response approach
- https://www.cutefela.com/species.html — species field guides
- https://www.cutefela.com/global-engagement.html — UN and international environmental engagement
- https://www.cutefela.com/partner.html — partnerships
- https://www.cutefela.com/contact.html — contact
- https://www.cutefela.com/privacy.html — privacy
- https://www.cutefela.com/cutefela-and-ai.html — AI disclosure
